decision.observed_event: Faint marks run along the card backs, and the dealer reads them as he deals.

appraisal.label: interest
appraisal.cause: The cheat is exposed in front of the table.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren exposes the marks on the card backs with a successful Investigation.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl lies and blames others for his failures; caught, he shifts the blame to his own man.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit lets the dealer lie badly under pressure instead of confessing, and lets the scared bandit's reaction show it.

public_brief.objective: Save face by putting the blame anywhere but himself.
public_brief.tactic: Feign outrage and blame the nervous player beside him for the deck.
public_brief.visible_cue: One player goes grey; another slides a hand off the table.
public_brief.player_opening: She can call the lie, press the frightened player, or demand her stake back.
public_brief.reply_to: show everyone the marks on the backs
public_brief.kit_focus: Let the frightened player's stammer contradict the dealer without anyone saying so.
public_brief.mirror: high energy, standard, no humor: let the lie scramble

claims.truth: The dealer's deck carries subtle marks and he deals seconds.
claims.speaker: uktarl
claims.version: He brought this deck; he swore it was clean.
claims.why: Uktarl blames others for his failures and wants to keep control of the table.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Turned to the candlelight, the card backs show it plainly: tiny nicks and shadings along the borders, different on every card. The door-side player goes grey under his white face. The fresco-side player's hand slides off the table.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Marks? Ah. Ah, you see, this is what comes of letting him shuffle. He brought this deck, my lady, he swore it was clean. I play with what my brothers give me, and now I am the one shamed in front of a guest. You owe this lady an apology, and me a new deck. Well?

segments.speaker: Door-side player
segments.text: I never... it was your... I didn't bring...

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.reacts_to: You owe this lady an apology
